WHAT IS ATUKO

Atuko (Yoruba: "driver", also called "Flow" internally) is a Chrome MV3 browser automation extension for engineers. It lets you record, build, and run multi-step workflows directly in Chrome with no external tools or cloud dependency. Every workflow is a single JSON document that you can version-control, share, or generate programmatically. Workflows can be imported into the extension via the builder's Import button.


WORKFLOW JSON — TOP-LEVEL FIELDS

A workflow is a JSON object with the following fields:

  id           string   UUID v4 uniquely identifying this workflow
  name         string   Human-readable display name
  description  string   Optional description
  site         string   Hostname only, e.g. "example.com" — no protocol, no path
  version      number   Always 1
  enabled      boolean  Whether the workflow can be triggered automatically
  triggers     array    One or more TriggerObject items (see TRIGGERS)
  steps        array    Ordered array of StepObject items (see STEP TYPES)
  variables    object   Key-value pairs of default workflow-scope variable values (strings)
  tags         array    String tags for organization
  createdAt    string   ISO 8601 datetime
  updatedAt    string   ISO 8601 datetime


TRIGGERS

Every workflow has a triggers array with one or more trigger objects.

ManualTrigger — fired explicitly by the user
  { "type": "manual" }

UrlMatchTrigger — fired when the user navigates to a matching URL
  type       "url-match"
  pattern    string    URL pattern to match
  matchType  string    "glob" | "exact" | "prefix" | "regex"
  matchOn    string    "load" | "domcontentloaded" | "urlchange"
  once       boolean   Fire only once per page visit if true
  delay      number    Milliseconds to wait after match before starting the workflow

ChainTrigger — fired when another workflow completes
  type           "chain"
  workflowId     string    UUID of the parent workflow
  onStatus       string    "success" | "any"
  passVariables  array     String array of variable names to inherit from the parent run


STEP BASE FIELDS

Every step object includes these fields regardless of type:

  id          string   UUID v4 — must be unique within the workflow
  type        string   Step type identifier (see STEP TYPES)
  label       string   Human-readable step name shown in the UI and run log
  note        string   Optional comment; not used at runtime
  enabled     boolean  Set to false to skip this step without removing it
  onError     string   "stop" | "skip" | "retry" | "branch"
  retries     number   Number of retry attempts on error, 0–5
  retryDelay  number   Milliseconds to wait between retries


SELECTOROBJECT

SelectorObject is used in any step that targets a DOM element.

  primary         string   The main selector to try first
  fallbacks       array    Ordered string array of fallback selectors to try if primary fails
  stabilityScore  number   0.0 to 1.0 — higher means more stable across code changes

Supported selector formats:

  CSS id                #submit-btn
  CSS data-testid       [data-testid="login-btn"]
  CSS attribute         [aria-label="Close dialog"]
  CSS class             .btn-primary
  CSS compound          form.login-form input[type="email"]
  XPath bare            //button[@id='x']   (starts with //)
  XPath prefixed        xpath=//button[normalize-space()='Log in']
  Site alias            @alias-name   (resolved from site config)

Stability score guidance:
  0.95  [data-testid], #id
  0.85  [aria-label], [name], [placeholder]
  0.75  xpath text match via normalize-space()
  0.60  CSS class
  0.40  positional XPath such as //div[3]/button[1]

Always include at least two fallbacks. For buttons and links, xpath=//button[normalize-space()='Label'] is the most resilient selector across code refactors.


STEP TYPES

There are 18 step types. Each section lists the type name, its purpose, and all type-specific fields in addition to the base fields.


TYPE: click
Purpose: Click a DOM element.

  selector       SelectorObject  Target element
  button         string          "left" | "right" | "middle"
  doubleClick    boolean         Double-click instead of single click
  waitBefore     number          Milliseconds to wait before clicking
  scrollIntoView boolean         Scroll element into viewport first
  force          boolean         Click even if element is not visible


TYPE: fill
Purpose: Type text into an input, textarea, or contenteditable element.

  selector       SelectorObject  Target element
  value          string          Text to type; supports {{var}} interpolation
  clearMethod    string          "select-all" | "triple-click" | "ctrl-a"
  append         boolean         Append to existing value instead of replacing
  simulateTyping boolean         Fire key events per character (for sites that listen to keydown/keyup)
  typingDelay    number          Milliseconds between simulated keystrokes
  pressEnter     boolean         Press Enter after filling


TYPE: wait
Purpose: Pause execution until a condition is met or a timeout occurs.

  waitType   string          "duration" | "element" | "element-gone" | "text" | "network"
  duration   number          Milliseconds to wait (for waitType "duration")
  selector   SelectorObject  Element to wait for (for waitType "element" or "element-gone")
  text       string          Page text to wait for (for waitType "text")
  timeout    number          Maximum milliseconds before onTimeout fires
  onTimeout  string          "stop" | "skip" | "branch"


TYPE: navigate
Purpose: Navigate the current tab to a URL.

  url       string  Destination URL; supports {{var}} interpolation
  waitUntil string  "load" | "domcontentloaded" | "networkidle"
  timeout   number  Maximum milliseconds to wait for navigation to complete


TYPE: scroll
Purpose: Scroll the page or a scrollable container.

  scrollType  string               "to" | "by" | "top" | "bottom" | "element"
  target      "page" or SelectorObject  What to scroll
  x           number               Horizontal amount in pixels
  y           number               Vertical amount in pixels
  behavior    string               "smooth" | "instant"


TYPE: submit
Purpose: Submit a form element programmatically.

  selector          SelectorObject  The form element to submit
  waitForNavigation boolean         Wait for page navigation after submit
  navigationTimeout number          Maximum milliseconds to wait for navigation


TYPE: select
Purpose: Choose an option in a <select> element.

  selector  SelectorObject  The <select> element
  by        string          "value" | "label" | "index"
  value     string|number   The option value, label text, or 0-based index to select


TYPE: hover
Purpose: Move the mouse over an element to trigger hover states.

  selector  SelectorObject  Target element
  duration  number          Milliseconds to hold the hover before moving on


TYPE: keypress
Purpose: Send keyboard events to the page or a focused element.

  key     string  Key identifier e.g. "Enter", "Escape", "Tab", "Ctrl+A", "ArrowDown", "F5"
  target  string  "page" — events are dispatched on the document
  repeat  number  Number of times to press the key
  delay   number  Milliseconds between repeated key presses


TYPE: extract
Purpose: Read a value from the DOM and store it in a variable.

  selector       SelectorObject  Target element
  property       string          "text" | "html" | "value" | "attribute" | "style"
  attribute      string          HTML attribute name (when property is "attribute")
  styleProperty  string          CSS property name (when property is "style")
  saveAs         string          Variable name to store the result
  transform      string          "none" | "trim" | "lowercase" | "uppercase" | "number"


TYPE: screenshot
Purpose: Capture an image of the viewport, full page, or a specific element.

  target    "viewport" | "page" | SelectorObject  What to capture
  filename  string   Filename for the saved image
  saveAs    string   Optional variable name to store the resulting data URI


TYPE: tab
Purpose: Open, close, or switch between browser tabs.

  action     string  "open" | "close" | "switch" | "close-others"
  url        string  URL to open (for action "open"); supports {{var}} interpolation
  waitUntil  string  "load" | "domcontentloaded"
  saveTabId  string  Optional variable name to store the new tab ID


TYPE: clipboard
Purpose: Read from or write to the system clipboard.

  action  string  "read" | "write"
  value   string  Text to write (for action "write"); supports {{var}} interpolation
  saveAs  string  Variable name to store clipboard contents (for action "read")


TYPE: storage
Purpose: Read or write browser localStorage or sessionStorage.

  action  string  "get" | "set" | "remove" | "clear"
  store   string  "local" | "session"
  key     string  Storage key name
  value   string  Value to write (for action "set")
  saveAs  string  Variable name to store the retrieved value (for action "get")


TYPE: log
Purpose: Write a message to the run log.

  message  string  Log message; supports {{var}} interpolation
  level    string  "info" | "warn" | "error"


TYPE: prompt
Purpose: Ask the user for input during a run, displayed in the toast overlay.

  promptType  string  "text" | "password" | "select"
  message     string  Prompt message shown to the user
  saveAs      string  Variable name to store the user's response
  countdown   number  Seconds before the prompt auto-dismisses


TYPE: setVariable
Purpose: Set or compute a variable value at runtime.

  name       string  Variable name
  value      string  Value to assign; supports {{var}} interpolation
  scope      string  "run" | "workflow" | "site" | "global"
  transform  string  "none" | "trim" | "lowercase" | "uppercase" | "number" | "json-parse"


TYPE: branch
Purpose: Conditionally execute different sets of steps based on a runtime condition.

  condition  ConditionObject  The condition to evaluate
  then       array            Ordered string array of step IDs to execute if condition is true
  else       array            Ordered string array of step IDs to execute if condition is false
  mergeAt    string           Step ID to resume execution at after the branch finishes


TYPE: loop
Purpose: Repeat a set of steps a fixed number of times, while a condition holds, or over an array.

  loopType       string           "count" | "while" | "for-each"
  count          number           Number of iterations (for loopType "count")
  condition      ConditionObject  Loop condition (for loopType "while")
  items          string           Variable name holding a JSON array (for loopType "for-each")
  itemAs         string           Variable name for the current item in each iteration
  steps          array            Ordered string array of step IDs forming the loop body
  maxIterations  number           Safety cap — loop stops after this many iterations regardless


TYPE: stop
Purpose: Immediately halt the workflow run with an explicit status.

  reason  string  Human-readable reason for stopping
  status  string  "success" | "failure" | "cancelled"


TYPE: jump
Purpose: Unconditionally transfer execution to a specific step.

  stepId  string  UUID of the step to jump to


CONDITIONOBJECT

Used in branch and loop steps to evaluate a runtime condition.

  type         string          Condition type:
                               "variable" — evaluate a variable value
                               "element-exists" — check if an element is in the DOM
                               "element-missing" — check if an element is absent from the DOM
                               "element-text" — check the text content of an element
                               "element-value" — check the value property of an input element
                               "url-matches" — check the current tab URL against a pattern
                               "response-contains" — check the body of an intercepted network response

  selector     SelectorObject  Target element (required for element-* types)
  variable     string          Variable name to evaluate (required for type "variable")
  operator     string          "equals" | "not-equals" | "contains" | "not-contains" |
                               "starts-with" | "ends-with" | "greater-than" | "less-than" |
                               "is-empty" | "is-not-empty"
  value        string          The comparison value
  pattern      string          URL pattern string (for type "url-matches")
  responseVar  string          Variable name holding the response body (for type "response-contains")


VARIABLE SCOPES

Variables are stored in one of four scopes. The scope determines lifetime and sharing.

  run       Lives only for the current run. Cleared automatically when the run ends.
  workflow  Persists across runs, but only for this specific workflow.
  site      Persists across runs and is shared by all workflows on the same hostname.
  global    Persists across runs and is shared by all workflows on all sites.

Variable interpolation syntax: {{variableName}}

Use {{variableName}} in any string field. For built-in variables, use a $ prefix: {{$url}}, {{$runId}}, etc.

Default values for workflow-scope variables can be set in the top-level "variables" object of the workflow JSON.


BUILT-IN VARIABLES (READ-ONLY)

These are always available in any workflow. Reference them as {{$name}}.

  $url        Current tab full URL
  $title      Current page document title
  $timestamp  Unix timestamp in milliseconds (integer string)
  $date       Current date as YYYY-MM-DD
  $time       Current time as HH:MM:SS
  $runId      UUID of the current run
  $stepIndex  0-based index of the step currently executing
  $iteration  Current iteration count inside a loop (1-based)
  $item       Current item value in a for-each loop


COMPLETE MINIMAL EXAMPLE WORKFLOW

The following workflow navigates to a login page, fills email and password, clicks the submit button, waits for the dashboard, and extracts a value.

{
  "id": "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
  "name": "Minimal Login Example",
  "description": "Navigate, fill, click, wait, extract",
  "site": "example.com",
  "version": 1,
  "enabled": true,
  "triggers": [{ "type": "manual" }],
  "variables": { "email": "user@example.com", "password": "secret" },
  "tags": [],
  "createdAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "s1",
      "type": "navigate",
      "label": "Go to login page",
      "enabled": true,
      "onError": "stop",
      "retries": 0,
      "retryDelay": 0,
      "url": "https://example.com/login",
      "waitUntil": "domcontentloaded",
      "timeout": 10000
    },
    {
      "id": "s2",
      "type": "fill",
      "label": "Fill email",
      "enabled": true,
      "onError": "stop",
      "retries": 1,
      "retryDelay": 500,
      "selector": {
        "primary": "[data-testid='email-input']",
        "fallbacks": ["input[type='email']", "input[name='email']"],
        "stabilityScore": 0.95
      },
      "value": "{{email}}",
      "clearMethod": "select-all",
      "append": false,
      "simulateTyping": false,
      "typingDelay": 0,
      "pressEnter": false
    },
    {
      "id": "s3",
      "type": "fill",
      "label": "Fill password",
      "enabled": true,
      "onError": "stop",
      "retries": 1,
      "retryDelay": 500,
      "selector": {
        "primary": "[data-testid='password-input']",
        "fallbacks": ["input[type='password']", "input[name='password']"],
        "stabilityScore": 0.95
      },
      "value": "{{password}}",
      "clearMethod": "select-all",
      "append": false,
      "simulateTyping": false,
      "typingDelay": 0,
      "pressEnter": false
    },
    {
      "id": "s4",
      "type": "click",
      "label": "Click submit",
      "enabled": true,
      "onError": "stop",
      "retries": 1,
      "retryDelay": 500,
      "selector": {
        "primary": "xpath=//button[normalize-space()='Log in']",
        "fallbacks": ["button[type='submit']", "[data-testid='login-btn']"],
        "stabilityScore": 0.75
      },
      "button": "left",
      "doubleClick": false,
      "waitBefore": 0,
      "scrollIntoView": true,
      "force": false
    },
    {
      "id": "s5",
      "type": "wait",
      "label": "Wait for dashboard",
      "enabled": true,
      "onError": "stop",
      "retries": 0,
      "retryDelay": 0,
      "waitType": "element",
      "selector": {
        "primary": "[data-testid='dashboard']",
        "fallbacks": ["#dashboard", "main.dashboard"],
        "stabilityScore": 0.9
      },
      "timeout": 15000,
      "onTimeout": "stop"
    },
    {
      "id": "s6",
      "type": "extract",
      "label": "Extract username",
      "enabled": true,
      "onError": "skip",
      "retries": 0,
      "retryDelay": 0,
      "selector": {
        "primary": "[data-testid='user-name']",
        "fallbacks": [".user-greeting", "#username"],
        "stabilityScore": 0.9
      },
      "property": "text",
      "saveAs": "userName",
      "transform": "trim"
    }
  ]
}


TIPS FOR AI AGENTS GENERATING SELECTORS

Use this priority order when choosing selectors:

1. [data-testid="x"]          Stability 0.95 — most reliable, use whenever available
2. #semantic-id               Stability 0.95 — use only for stable, semantic IDs (not auto-generated)
3. [aria-label="x"]           Stability 0.85 — reliable for buttons and interactive elements
4. [name="x"], [placeholder]  Stability 0.85 — reliable for form inputs
5. xpath=//button[normalize-space()='Label']   Stability 0.75 — best for buttons and links by text content
6. .semantic-class-name       Stability 0.60 — only use if class names are stable and semantic
7. Positional XPath           Stability 0.40 — last resort only, brittle across DOM changes

Always populate the fallbacks array with at least two alternatives in priority order.

For buttons and links, always include the xpath text variant as a fallback even if a higher-priority selector is used as primary.

Use waitType "element" rather than "duration" wherever possible. Element waits are faster and more resilient to variable network and render times.

Set a timeout on every wait step. Decide explicitly whether onTimeout should be "stop", "skip", or "branch" — never leave it undefined.

Always include retries: 1 and retryDelay: 500 on click and fill steps interacting with dynamically rendered content.

Variable interpolation {{variableName}} works in any string field: url, value, message, key, filename, and others. Reference built-in read-only variables with a $ prefix: {{$url}}, {{$date}}, {{$runId}}.

Every step ID must be a unique string within the workflow. UUIDs are preferred but any unique string is valid.
